The CFBReader class provides access to the CFB header via the header property, exposing sector_size, mini_sector_size, and major_version.
MsgWriter: Serializer that writes a MsgDocument into a CFB-backed .msg payload.
The CFBReader class supports reading stream data from CFB containers using get_stream_data() and resolving paths by name using resolve_path() and find_child_by_name().
MapiMessage.create() is part of the public API for Aspose.Email FOSS.
The CFBReader class supports opening CFB containers from files using the from_file() class method.
The CFBReader class exposes metadata about the CFB container including sector_size, mini_sector_size, fat_sector_count, directory_entry_count, and file_size.
The library supports reading Outlook .msg files through both high-level MapiMessage and low-level MsgReader APIs.
The MapiMessage class supports creating new messages programmatically using the static create() method and saving them as Outlook-compatible .msg files.
The MapiMessage class provides access to its internal MSG reader via the msg_reader property, enabling low-level inspection of property streams and container structure.
